title: the Outer Planes seal
audit_comment: THE OUTER PLANES CHAPTER SEAL, printed pp. 73-116: the parent box closes on the census of its children. The seventeen named planes in their wheel order - Nirvana, Arcadia, the Seven Heavens, the Twin Paradises, Elysium, the Happy Hunting Grounds, Olympus and Gladsheim on the lawful-good arc; Limbo and Pandemonium in chaos; the Abyss, Tarterus and Hades in the evil middle; Gehenna, the Nine Hells and Acheron on the lawful-evil slope; and the Concordant Opposition at the hub, the seventeenth touching all. The chapter's rounds: the general doctrine of R577 with the plane-shift arrival table, the alteration-spells chaos table, the turning-undead alignment modifiers, the unique-powers 2-or-20 rule and the human-travelers doctrine; the plane rounds R578 through R589 - Nirvana and Arcadia together, the Seven Heavens with the Twin Paradises, Elysium with the Happy Hunting Grounds, Olympus with Gladsheim closing the Upper Planes, Limbo with Pandemonium opening the Chaos side, the Abyss alone, Tarterus, Hades, Gehenna, the Nine Hells, Acheron, and the Concordant Opposition with its center and destination tables - the Beastlands casting table reattributed by amendment; and the closing essay of R590. Every child box flipped; the wheel sealed.

consts.name: dduOuterPlaneCount
consts.comment: the seventeen named planes of the outer planes: the planes of power circling the wheel - Nirvana and Arcadia on the lawful side, the Seven Heavens, the Twin Paradises, Elysium and the Happy Hunting Grounds of the good ascent, Olympus and Gladsheim of the neutrals, Limbo and Pandemonium of pure and evil chaos, the Abyss, Tarterus, Hades of the evil middle, Gehenna and the Nine Hells of lawful evil's slope, Acheron between the Hells and Nirvana - and Concordant Opposition at the hub, the seventeenth, touching all.

bools.name: dduWheelOrder
bools.comment: the wheel arrangement (the book's own doctrine): the outer planes arranged by alignment around the Great Wheel, each plane the home of its alignment's Powers - the lawful-evil ascent from Gehenna's furnaces through the Nine Hells to Acheron's iron blocks and Nirvana's clockwork; the good arc from Arcadia's orchards up through the Seven Heavens, the Twin Paradises, Elysium and the Happy Hunting Grounds to Olympus and Gladsheim; the chaos descent from Limbo's quicksilver through Pandemonium's howls into the Abyss, Tarterus and the grey Glooms of Hades; and Concordant Opposition at the center, the exception plane connecting them all - the alignment-arrangement doctrine pinned in the general round and carried by every plane's own round.

bools.name: dduChapterSeal
bools.comment: the chapter seal: the Outer Planes chapter of the Manual of the Planes is closed - the general doctrine of R577 (the reaching, the survival, the movement, the encounters, the combat, the magic, the player characters, the features, and the Great Wheel itself) with its tables (the plane-shift arrival, the alteration-spells chaos, the turning modifiers, the unique-powers and human-travelers doctrines), the seventeen plane rounds R578 through R589 from Nirvana to the Concordant Opposition with their five tables (the Limbo entry, the Abyss terrain, the center and destination tables of the Opposition, the Beastlands casting reattribution), and the closing essay of R590 - every child box flipped, the parent sealed by this round's census pin.
